blockers.title: A second account signed in on the same phone uploads the first account's queued rows, and Esci gives no warning that changes are still unsent
blockers.evidence: src/persistence/backupLink.ts:29 calls switchToSyncedTables(db, key) without the account argument, so the device's backup-account mark is never written. src/backup/session.ts:95-98 connects any session on a device that is already synced and never compares accounts. signOutOfBackup leaves ps_crud as it is. Scratch spec with the fake backend: primo@example.test signed in, REST writes refused, status 'In attesa di connessione: 2 modifiche da inviare.' After one tap on Esci the section shows the sign-in form, with no dialog and no mention of the 2 unsent changes. A session for secondo@example.test is then stored and the page reloaded: the captured writes are 'POST courses as secondo@example.test' and 'POST students as secondo@example.test'.
blockers.reproduction: Throwaway spec (fake backend): create a course and a student; store a fake session for primo@ and reload; abort /rest/v1 writes, tap Esci; store a session for secondo@, reload and log the non-GET /rest/v1 requests.
blockers.specRef: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md B3 adversarial checklist: 'a second account on the same device, whose queue must never upload the first account's rows (SC-B1-Q5)'

importantFindings.title: Offline cold start the next morning (access token expired) shows the sign-in form although the session is still stored, and the backup does not resume when signal returns
importantFindings.evidence: session.ts maps a null session to 'signed-out' and ignores getSession's error. auth-js 2.117.3 __loadSession keeps the stored session after a retryable refresh failure but returns session:null with an error. Scratch run: expired session stored, every request aborted, reload: Impostazioni shows the sign-in form while localStorage still holds the session. No onAuthStateChange or online listener calls startBackup again before a relaunch.
importantFindings.reproduction: Scratch test 'switch, connected, then offline cold start with expired token' (pixel-7-chrome).
importantFindings.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §1 'show honest save, error and retry state'; 06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK R14

importantFindings.title: The launch-time switch reloads the app without asking and throws away what the instructor is typing
importantFindings.evidence: startBackupAtLaunch reloads as soon as startBackup returns 'reopen', after a network round trip. The update reload is protected by applyUpdateWhenSafe; this one is not. Scratch run with the courses response delayed 6 s: typed Nome 'Bravo' and Cognome 'Digitato' in a new student, one reload, the form empty.
importantFindings.reproduction: Scratch test 'wildcard: slow launch switch while typing' (pixel-7-chrome).

importantFindings.title: A link that is expired or opened in another browser lands silently on the sign-in form, and the copy does not warn about the browser
importantFindings.evidence: '/?code=<uuid>' with no verifier, and '#error=access_denied&error_code=otp_expired' or the same as a query string: the plain sign-in form with no message, the code or error kept in the address bar. With PKCE the link must open in the same browser storage that asked; on iPhone a home-screen app does not share storage with Safari, so sign-in from the installed app most likely cannot succeed; on Android, Gmail can open links in an in-app tab. The working tree's ?code message does not cover the #error / ?error forms.
importantFindings.reproduction: Scratch test 'link opened elsewhere or expired' (pixel-7-chrome).

importantFindings.title: The app that asked for the link is not told when sign-in completes in another tab
importantFindings.evidence: Page A shows 'Link inviato'; page B in the same context stores the session, switches and reloads; 14 s later page A still reads 'Link inviato … Aprilo su questo telefono per accedere.' No auth-state or storage listener exists in src/backup/.
importantFindings.reproduction: Scratch test 'link opened in a second tab while the app waits'.

importantFindings.title: A wrong tap on Esci cannot be undone in place: getting back in needs signal, the mail app and a new link
importantFindings.evidence: 'Esci' is one secondary button with no confirmation; the reassurance 'Il corso resta su questo telefono.' says nothing about changes that never reached the copy.
importantFindings.reproduction: Connected state, tap Esci: the sign-in form appears immediately.

qolFindings.title: 'Riprova' after a failed send does not resend; the error does not say the phone is offline
qolFindings.evidence: OnlineBackup.tsx runs startBackup, not sendSignInLink; offline the copy gives no cause and a retry takes 2 taps.

qolFindings.title: 'Link inviato' lives only in memory: after Android kills the PWA the screen shows the blank form
qolFindings.evidence: linkSentAfterReload shows the sign-in form, inviting a second send.

qolFindings.title: The Impostazioni summary still says 'Archivio: Locale' while the backup is connected
qolFindings.evidence: src/App.tsx hard-codes it, directly above 'Backup online … Accesso: …'.

qolFindings.title: The backup state is small grey text with no icon
qolFindings.evidence: 14 px muted text; the three states look identical apart from the words, hard to read in glare.

qolFindings.title: 'In attesa di connessione.' with zero pending changes reads as 'not backed up'
qolFindings.evidence: With every upload accepted and the sync stream aborted the line read 'In attesa di connessione.' with the queue at 0.
qolFindings.reproduction: Connected test with the sync URL aborted.

fieldWalkthrough: Evening sign-in then the morning on the pier: about 16 taps and two relaunches; three moments read twice ('Link inviato' after signing in, 'In attesa di connessione' with nothing to send, 'Archivio: Locale' next to the backup). Morning without signal: the sign-in form, the email typed again, 'Invio non riuscito. Riprova.', the form again. The course itself worked throughout and nothing scrolled sideways.
